name: Bounded achilles-supplement LFS pilot
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - cloud/achilles-supplement-lfs-pilot-20261023
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/achilles-supplement-lfs-pilot.yml
permissions: {}
jobs:
  upload-and-verify:
    if: github.repository == 'qianyizhang/med-assets' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/cloud/achilles-supplement-lfs-pilot-20261023'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0'
      APPROVED_MANIFEST: >-
        {"objects":[{"oid":"e38e33c1d0ceb791e4a2ad676dedd7923f53b5ad8d7dc8b195202565609354ea","size":517676,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/teaching/draft_muscle__achilles_context_20261023/e38e33c1d0ceb791e4a2ad676dedd7923f53b5ad8d7dc8b195202565609354ea.glb","type":"glb","file":"assemblies/musculoskeletal-teaching/2026-10-23/achilles-right-context.glb"},{"oid":"e2e1ad69e7baa9c05fae709e0b5089999029d95483f5842d8cf2c3b17766d1eb","size":717801,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/teaching/draft_muscle__achilles_context_20261023/e2e1ad69e7baa9c05fae709e0b5089999029d95483f5842d8cf2c3b17766d1eb.png","type":"png","file":"reviews/draft_muscle/2026-10-23-achilles-context/evidence/export-lateral.png"},{"oid":"40ff9f62ad55f9300510b5526b868e27a5bbcf30f93b68f6330a72b9d86b0599","size":711734,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/teaching/draft_muscle__achilles_context_20261023/40ff9f62ad55f9300510b5526b868e27a5bbcf30f93b68f6330a72b9d86b0599.png","type":"png","file":"reviews/draft_muscle/2026-10-23-achilles-context/evidence/export-posterior.png"},{"oid":"e996453161275bf8088825ac4907c0d021a203c235a542194d1b95c829cca599","size":988898,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/teaching/draft_muscle__achilles_context_20261023/e996453161275bf8088825ac4907c0d021a203c235a542194d1b95c829cca599.png","type":"png","file":"reviews/draft_muscle/2026-10-23-achilles-context/evidence/heel-close-lateral.png"},{"oid":"dfda037da0870a22d17745eebd52ceaefc6113b277a37ff3074480d9200ecde7","size":667857,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/teaching/draft_muscle__achilles_context_20261023/dfda037da0870a22d17745eebd52ceaefc6113b277a37ff3074480d9200ecde7.png","type":"png","file":"reviews/draft_muscle/2026-10-23-achilles-context/evidence/heel-close-neutral-oblique.png"},{"oid":"6297742f44760ccdf7af60c0efe50aebf6ed6f80f439f492ab1639a83fd15f48","size":1035265,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/teaching/draft_muscle__achilles_context_20261023/6297742f44760ccdf7af60c0efe50aebf6ed6f80f439f492ab1639a83fd15f48.png","type":"png","file":"reviews/draft_muscle/2026-10-23-achilles-context/evidence/heel-close-posterior.png"},{"oid":"00f0bb0465300403cb92db32a2fc1b2d9c29d79ae11f6d28802491b0ab5e4da1","size":571982,"url":"https://anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site/review/teaching/draft_muscle__achilles_context_20261023/00f0bb0465300403cb92db32a2fc1b2d9c29d79ae11f6d28802491b0ab5e4da1.png","type":"png","file":"reviews/draft_muscle/2026-10-23-achilles-context/evidence/neutral-oblique.png"}]}
    steps:
      - name: Configure temporary repository authentication
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          lfs: false
          submodules: false
          sparse-checkout: .gitattributes
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          persist-credentials: true
          show-progress: false
      - name: Verify sources, upload missing among 7 exact approved OIDs, and independently read back
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import gzip, hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, re, subprocess, urllib.parse, urllib.request
          
          import struct, math
          
          def verify_format(data, kind):
              if kind == 'glb':
                  assert len(data) >= 20 and data[:4] == b'glTF'
                  version, declared = struct.unpack_from('<II', data, 4)
                  assert version == 2 and declared == len(data)
                  return {'type':'glb','version':version,'declaredLengthMatches':True}
              if kind == 'png':
                  assert data[:8] == bytes([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10])
                  assert data[8:16] == bytes([0,0,0,13])+b'IHDR'
                  width,height = struct.unpack_from('>II',data,16)
                  assert width > 0 and height > 0
                  return {'type':'png','width':width,'height':height}
              if kind == 'obj':
                  assert b'\0' not in data
                  lines = data.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
                  vertices = 0
                  faces = []
                  for line in lines:
                      fields = line.split('#',1)[0].split()
                      if not fields:
                          continue
                      if fields[0] == 'v':
                          assert len(fields) >= 4 and all(math.isfinite(float(v)) for v in fields[1:])
                          vertices += 1
                      elif fields[0] == 'f':
                          assert len(fields) >= 4
                          indices = [int(v.split('/')[0]) for v in fields[1:]]
                          assert all(v != 0 for v in indices)
                          faces.append((vertices,indices))
                  assert vertices > 0 and faces
                  for seen,indices in faces:
                      assert all((1 <= v <= vertices) if v > 0 else (-seen <= v <= -1) for v in indices)
                  return {'type':'obj','utf8':True,'vertices':vertices,'faces':len(faces),'vertexIndicesValid':True}
              if kind == 'nii':
                  # NIfTI-1 layout: https://nifti.nimh.nih.gov/nifti-1/documentation/nifti1fields.html
                  assert len(data) >= 352 and data[344:348] == b'n+1\0'
                  endian = '<' if struct.unpack_from('<i',data)[0] == 348 else '>'
                  assert struct.unpack_from(endian+'i',data)[0] == 348
                  dims = struct.unpack_from(endian+'8h',data,40)
                  datatype,bitpix = struct.unpack_from(endian+'2h',data,70)
                  offset = struct.unpack_from(endian+'f',data,108)[0]
                  # Exact publicly approved source's uncompressed int16 100-cube layout.
                  assert dims == (3,100,100,100,1,1,1,1) and datatype == 4 and bitpix == 16 and offset == 352
                  assert len(data) == int(offset) + math.prod(dims[1:dims[0]+1]) * (bitpix//8)
                  assert not any(data[4:32]) and not any(data[148:252]) and not any(data[328:344])
                  assert not any(data[348:352])
                  return {'type':'nii','niftiVersion':1,'dimensions':list(dims[1:4]),'datatype':datatype,'bitpix':bitpix,'voxelOffset':int(offset),'dataLengthMatches':True,'textFieldsEmpty':True,'extensionFlagsEmpty':True}
              raise AssertionError('Unapproved content type')
          
          manifest = json.loads(os.environ["APPROVED_MANIFEST"])
          objects = manifest["objects"]
          assert len(objects) == 7 and len({o["oid"] for o in objects}) == 7, "Unexpected object count"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) == 5211213, "Unexpected total bytes"
          assert sum(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 5211213, "Approved batch cap exceeded"
          assert max(o["size"] for o in objects) <= 1035265, "Per-object limit exceeded"
          assert all(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", o["oid"]) and 0 < o["size"] <= 1035265 for o in objects), "Invalid object constraints"
          work = pathlib.Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"], "achilles-supplement-approved-pilot")
          work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          
          # Every source is public. Do not read or pass GitHub credentials to source URLs.
          for o in objects:
              parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(o["url"])
              assert parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname in {"anatomy-verification.landy123007.chatgpt.site"}, "Unapproved source host"
              assert parsed.username is None and parsed.password is None, "Credentials in URL refused"
              encoding = o.get("encoding", "identity")
              assert encoding in {"identity", "gzip"}, "Unapproved source encoding"
              transfer_size = o.get("transportSize", o["size"])
              transfer_oid = o.get("transportOid", o["oid"])
              assert 0 < transfer_size <= 1035265 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", transfer_oid), "Invalid transport constraints"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  assert "transportSize" in o and "transportOid" in o, "Gzip transport manifest required"
              else:
                  assert transfer_size == o["size"] and transfer_oid == o["oid"], "Identity transport mismatch"
              req = urllib.request.Request(o["url"], headers={"User-Agent": "med-assets-achilles-supplement-pilot/1.0", "Accept-Encoding": "identity"})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS redirect refused"
                  transport = response.read(transfer_size + 1)
              assert len(transport) == transfer_size and hashlib.sha256(transport).hexdigest() == transfer_oid, "Transport size or SHA-256 mismatch"
              if encoding == "gzip":
                  with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=io.BytesIO(transport)) as compressed:
                      data = compressed.read(o["size"] + 1)
              else:
                  data = transport
              assert len(data) == o["size"], "Source size mismatch"
              assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == o["oid"], "Source SHA-256 mismatch"
              verify_format(data, o["type"])
              (work / o["oid"]).write_bytes(data)
              print(f"SOURCE VERIFIED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "version"], check=True)
          subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "install", "--local"], check=True)
          # Validate every LFS pointer before uploading any object.
          for o in objects:
              with (work / o["oid"]).open("rb") as source:
                  clean = subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "clean", "approved-" + o["oid"]], stdin=source, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, check=True)
              expected = f"version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1\noid sha256:{o['oid']}\nsize {o['size']}\n".encode()
              assert clean.stdout == expected, "Generated LFS pointer mismatch"
          # Query destination again and upload only genuinely missing approved objects.
          preflight_endpoint = "https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch"
          preflight_payload = json.dumps({"operation":"download","transfers":["basic"],"objects":[{"oid":o["oid"],"size":o["size"]} for o in objects]}).encode()
          preflight_headers = {"Accept":"application/vnd.git-lfs+json","Content-Type":"application/vnd.git-lfs+json"}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(preflight_endpoint,data=preflight_payload,headers=preflight_headers),timeout=45) as response:
              preflight_result = json.load(response)
          preflight_objects = {o["oid"]:o for o in preflight_result.get("objects",[])}
          assert set(preflight_objects) == {o["oid"] for o in objects}, "Unexpected preflight objects"
          missing = set()
          for o in objects:
              remote = preflight_objects[o["oid"]]
              assert remote.get("size") == o["size"]
              error = remote.get("error")
              if error:
                  assert error.get("code") == 404, "Destination returned an error other than missing object; stop"
                  missing.add(o["oid"])
              else:
                  assert remote.get("actions",{}).get("download"), "Destination unavailable"
          for o in objects:
              if o["oid"] not in missing:
                  print(f"ALREADY PRESENT SKIPPED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes",flush=True)
                  continue
              subprocess.run(["git", "lfs", "push", "--object-id", "origin", o["oid"]], check=True)
              print(f"UPLOAD COMMAND PASSED {o['oid']} {o['size']} bytes", flush=True)
          
          # Independent HTTP readback, without the local LFS cache or GitHub user credentials.
          endpoint = "https://github.com/qianyizhang/med-assets.git/info/lfs/objects/batch"
          payload = json.dumps({"operation": "download", "transfers": ["basic"], "objects": [{"oid": o["oid"], "size": o["size"]} for o in objects]}).encode()
          headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "Content-Type": "application/vnd.git-lfs+json", "User-Agent": "med-assets-achilles-supplement-pilot-readback/1.0"}
          with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(endpoint, data=payload, headers=headers), timeout=45) as response:
              result = json.load(response)
          returned = {o["oid"]: o for o in result.get("objects", [])}
          assert set(returned) == {o["oid"] for o in objects}, "Unexpected LFS Batch objects"
          for expected in objects:
              obj = returned[expected["oid"]]
              assert obj.get("size") == expected["size"] and "error" not in obj, "GitHub object unavailable"
              action = obj.get("actions", {}).get("download")
              assert action and urllib.parse.urlsplit(action["href"]).scheme == "https", "Invalid LFS download action"
              req = urllib.request.Request(action["href"], headers=action.get("header", {}))
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=45) as response:
                  assert urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.url).scheme == "https", "Non-HTTPS LFS redirect refused"
                  data = response.read(expected["size"] + 1)
              assert len(data) == expected["size"] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected["oid"], "GitHub LFS readback mismatch"
              verify_format(data, expected["type"])
              print(f"GITHUB READBACK VERIFIED {expected['oid']} {len(data)} bytes", flush=True)
          print("PASS: 7 exact objects; 5211213 bytes; no Git asset pointer or branch-tip commit pushed by this job.", flush=True)
          PY
